# Character Creation (Life Path)

::: {.callout-note title="Archived Build Draft"}
*This page documents an experimental Life Path draft for historical comparison. The official character build uses the [Point Buy Build](character_build_point_buy.qmd).*
:::

The character was created using the Life Path rules in 6WC.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Initial stats
Body = 0
Agility = 0
Reaction = 0
Strength = 0
Willpower = 0
Logic = 0
Intuition = 0
Charisma = 0
Magic = 0
Edge = 0

Athletics = 0
Con = 0
Influence = 0
Perception = 0
Sorcery = 0

Karma = 0
Nuyen = 0
Contact_Points = 0

MCT = "K"
Small_Unit_Tactics = "K"
Wuxing = "K"

def inc(name, amount=1):
    globals()[name] += amount
    op = "+=" if amount >= 0 else "-="
    return f"{name} {op} {abs(amount)}"

def assign(name, value):
    globals()[name] = value
    return f"{name} = {value}"

def inc_many(*pairs):
    res = []
    for name, amount in pairs:
        globals()[name] += amount
        op = "+=" if amount >= 0 else "-="
        res.append(f"{name} {op} {abs(amount)}")
    return ", ".join(res)
```

## Born This Way

* Starting Karma: `{python} assign('Karma', 50)`
* Metatype: Elf
* Metavariant: Dalekitnon `{python} inc('Karma', -5)`
* Starting Attributes
  * Any attributes for which your metatype has an increased maximum (higher than six) start at 2. 
  * All other attributes start at 1. 
  * Dalekitnon have increased maximums for Agility, Logic, Intuition, and Charisma
* Attribute Values
  * `{python} assign('Agility', 2)`
  * `{python} assign('Charisma', 2)`
  * `{python} assign('Body', 1)`
  * `{python} assign('Reaction', 1)`
  * `{python} assign('Strength', 1)`
  * `{python} assign('Willpower', 1)`
  * `{python} assign('Logic', 2)`
  * `{python} assign('Intuition', 2)`
  * `{python} assign('Edge', 1)`
* If you’re a full magician, mystic adept, or adept, gain `{python} assign('Magic', 1)`
* Metagenic Qualities
  * None allowed per SRMg p.54
* Awakened: Mystic Adept
* Nationality: Philippines
* Native Language: English
* Qualities
  * Exceptional Attribute - CHA: `{python} inc('Karma', -12)`
  * Injury Prone (R3): `{python} inc('Karma', 15)`

## Coming of Age: Early Adult and the Transition to Adulthood

* Choose one skill as your strongest talent
  * Sorcery: `{python} assign('Sorcery', 4)`
* Define your character's best attribute (cannot be Edge, Magic, or Resonance)
  * Charisma: `{python} inc('Charisma', 5)`
* Qualities
  * Chronic Pain: `{python} inc('Karma', 15)`
* Childhood Contact: 4 Points: `{python} inc_many(('Contact_Points', 4), ('Nuyen', 25000))`

## Adult Life Modules

### Adept Training

* Choose one: +1 to Edge or Magic: `{python} inc('Magic')`
* Choose one: +1 to Body, Agility, Reaction, or Strength: `{python} inc('Reaction')`
* Choose one: +1 to Charisma, Intuition, Logic, or Willpower: `{python} inc('Willpower')`
* Choose one: +1 to any skill: `{python} inc('Sorcery')`
* Contact Points: `{python} inc('Contact_Points', 2)`
* Knowledge Skill: Small Unit Tactics

### Traveler

* Choose one: +1 to any physical attribute: `{python} inc('Body')`
* Choose one: +1 to any mental attribute: `{python} inc('Willpower')`
* Choose one: +1 Edge or +25,000 nuyen: `{python} inc('Edge')`
* Choose one: +1 to any one skill: `{python} inc('Sorcery')`

### Mystic Adept
